# E06 build plan

Plan for independent review, not an implementation greenlight. Build E06-01/02/03 from docs/product/tdd/E06.md:15 and R09/R11/R29 from docs/product/PRD.md:485. No E06 technical design, request file or E06 review files exist. No design is created or edited. The requests below must be published and settled before affected implementation begins. A disabled acquisition does not satisfy camera acceptance.

## Ownership and repository evidence

hub/, ui/, workers/camera/ and eval/ are absent. contracts/ and config/ contain pharmacy artifacts only; the root pyproject.toml belongs to that engine. E01's generated contracts/kernel/fakes, E05 acquisition and E21's harness are not delivered.

SYSTEM assigns workers/camera/ with package crew_health_camera and a per-epic eval/scenarios/<epic>/ folder (docs/SYSTEM.md:133,137,1647). tasks.json proposes their conventional src/member-file expansion and keeps worker tests inside its package. Because no E06 section 13 or literal worker file inventory exists, C1 must ratify those exact paths before creation. They are explicit reservations awaiting approval, not claimed verbatim design paths.

E30 reserves workers/camera/src/crew_camera/analyzers/compression_rate/ and workers/camera/tests/compression_rate/ (docs/tdd/E30.md:1150). E06 claims neither these nor their parents. E20 owns deployment/CLI/supervision; E01 records/configuration/assembly; E02 identity/consent; E05 measurement/UI; E03 copy/shell; E21 shared fixtures/runner/panel. SYSTEM section 4 specifies no E06 hub module or tables, so none are planned. All current task ownership lists and other designs' section 13 reservations were inspected for overlap; recheck before dispatch as manifests arrive concurrently.

There is no source-import dependency between tasks, so both manifests have depends_on []. T2 never imports or duplicates T1's analyzer. Its final runtime gate explicitly requires the built worker. T1's process integration tests need the real hub but not T2's implementation. Both tasks have their own tests; overall acceptance joins their evidence. Optional E30 integration is separately enabled only after C2. No external call occurs inside a hub write transaction.

The normal path is authenticated person/operator selection, E05 request acceptance and pinned dispatch, capture on the device holding the camera, independent pulse/breathing quality decisions, then authenticated recordAttempt into E05. E05 and E01 atomically record attempts and observations through their existing owners, including audit, receipts and replication. Read back through getMeasurementRequest/getObservation, not SQL. Public measurement_request.changed is E05's event; E06 creates no public event or Job kind (docs/product/api/openapi.yaml:4758,4935; docs/SYSTEM.md sections 4.2,5.7,5.10.1).

## Design decisions

These choices settle the product brief's implementation questions. They are not measured accuracy claims; C2/C3 supply missing shared contracts and parameters before affected code.

* **Signals:** deterministic POS with separately reported CHROM corroboration; independent torso-landmark motion/periodicity for breathing. No inferred breathing, interpolation, algorithm averaging or clipped-band result. Reject insufficient/ambiguous signals separately (docs/BUILD-CHARTER.md:47; docs/product/PRD.md:420).
* **Selection:** quality-qualified source per indicator/window, approved quality ordering and stable device-ID tie break. Retain every real source, choice/reason and conflict. Agreeing views remain correlated, not an independent medical reference (docs/product/PRD.md:487; docs/tdd/E30.md:25).
* **Pairing:** explicit verified participant/session association; unpaired/ambiguous frames discarded locally. Station login, likeness and display name never authorize chart writes. E02/E05 recheck subject/operator/device/consent/generation at ingest. Optional face evaluation remains separate and cannot authenticate a write (docs/product/PRD.md:437; docs/tdd/E02.md:233).
* **Processes:** frames stay ephemeral on the capturing device. Workers use generated authenticated HTTP boundaries, never hub implementation imports or SQL. E05 uses SYSTEM 5.10.1 internal tasks with public_kind null; E20 enforces health/restart budgets. Reject busy work before capture; C3 registers finite buffers/admission/results/tickets. No E06 queue, ledger, recovery framework or general plugin system.
* **Time:** SYSTEM 5.2 capture/segment/correction provenance and D3 observation-time freshness. Inject monotonic time within an epoch; normalize durable intervals after restart. Window duration/ticket lifetime/retry/lease are elapsed; consent expiry and a stated UTC endpoint are absolute. Unknown/discontinuous time yields no accepted rate. SYSTEM 5.3 owns mission labels; midnight creates no completion credit.
* **Failure:** primary camera, dissimilar manual pulse/breathing backup, fail-safe not measured with reason. Verified-officer manual capture remains available for an incapacitated subject. Camera/model/device/ground failure cannot disable help/warnings/manual entry. SYSTEM 5.5 to 5.12 and 8.3/8.6 govern errors, pins, transactions, receipts, privacy and durable capture; storage/I/O/integrity errors never become quality refusals.

Operational inventory, from docs/SYSTEM.md sections 3/5.11. These are settings, never clinical configuration or request-code literals. Unknown descriptors/limits block worker startup under C3.

| Settings | Bound and source |
|---|---|
| workers.camera.timeout_ms | Every external worker call; finite limit must be supplied under C3 |
| workers.camera.health_ms | Health interval, section 3 default 5 s |
| workers.camera.restart_max, workers.camera.restart_window_ms, workers.camera.backoff_max_ms | E20 supervision: 5 crashes in 10 min, backoff up to 60 s, then unavailable until restarted |
| workers.camera.rss_mb, workers.camera.cpus | Section 3 budget 1 GB and 2 cores; E20 owns enforcement |
| tasks.max_pending, tasks.max_attempts, tasks.lease_ms, tasks.max_input_bytes, tasks.max_result_bytes | E01 runner admission/leases/retry/staging, enforced by E05 dispatch; descriptors in SYSTEM 5.11 |
| Additional frame/sample/window/camera/inflight/result/ticket/scan bounds | Exact keys, types and finite maxima are not published; C3 must supply them before the affected service can start |

## End-to-end evidence

T2 owns the rows below in eval/scenarios/E06/. Drive actual create_app(settings) HTTP with real temporary SQLite/authentication/configuration/measurement/records, or Playwright against that running hub. No internal mocks or dependency overrides. Approved explicit SIM/REPLAY external adapters support hermetic faults; LIVE capture is separate required evidence. T1 owns complementary worker-process integration tests in its package.

| Trace | What the case proves |
|---|---|
| E06-01, R09, V05, V06 | Pulse succeeds with shoulders absent and respiration fails separately. Movement, low light, saturated/stuck input, frame gaps, irregular times, nonfinite arithmetic and an out-of-band peak produce no invented/clipped accepted value. API readback and the measurement UI show the distinct failure |
| E06-02, R11, V07 | Multiple qualified views disagree; all available measurements, actual devices, choice and reason survive readback, restart and event delivery. No averaging away the conflict; one webcam remains sufficient |
| E06-02, R29, V08, V39 | Unpaired, ambiguous, stale or revoked binding, wrong subject/device/adapter and uncertain optional identity cannot create a patient observation. A valid explicit pairing is the positive control. Face experiment absent is reported not measured; it never becomes implicit authentication |
| V09, V47, D09 | LIVE presenter capture goes to the authenticated demo-operator, keeps selected camera and disagreement, and leaves Mara's SIM baseline/streak/goal unchanged. CI checks the partition invariant with labeled data; only table_min with actual cameras can earn D09, including its agreeing-view clause |
| V05, V23, D08 | First movement failure persists with its configured reason and no value/observation ID. A later explicit capture preserves that history; failed evidence is never usable assessment support. E15/E12/E13 provide timeline/support counterparts, not E06 copies |
| V11, V13, V16, V35; AGENTS 1.6 | Camera absent/down, duplicate dispatch, cancellation/late reply, lost acknowledgment, concurrent starts, hub/worker death at every capture/handoff/commit boundary and disk full. Exactly one accepted logical result; unknown physical state requires reconciliation. Late real evidence remains attributed/quarantined until approved review, not silently erased. Direct manual capture and fixed help remain usable |
| V14, V15; D3, D12, AGENTS 1.5/1.8 | Old input arriving now, clock reset with identical timestamps in different segments, correction in either direction, new process epoch and mission midnight preserve observation time/unit/origin. Unknown time cannot become current, stale input cannot replace newer state, and unsupported units fail without guessing |
| V75; AGENTS 1.1 | A sourced non-safety label or quality-explanation edit changes served/rendered content with no code edit. New work sees the new release, open work retains pins, corrupt/missing configuration rejects activation and retains last good. No safety mapping edit |
| V01, V69; AGENTS 1.3/1.4/1.7 | With camera/model/devices/ground absent or capture saturated, real manual entry and fixed help remain reachable; first help screen meets the charter 500 ms requirement. Cross-person reads/events/caches/logs and unauthorized worker publication fail closed. No assistant path can start unauthorized capture or change warnings. Reuse E21's verified observer and E20 load/fault hooks |
| V85, V86, V87; Q8 | When the optional real E30 bridge is integrated, agree/disagree/no-reference preserve manual input and available camera input. Disagree retains retry/incomplete step; no-reference is unchecked and excluded from support. No ECG gap closure, diagnosis or reward from a camera value. E30 owns comparison/plan/skill state; no required E06 core gate waits for this optional provider |
| E06-03, R46 contribution, V80 | Freeze the venue protocol, participant-held-out partition, algorithm/release hashes and consent before trials. Reproduce pulse MAE/bias, refusals/coverage and one-view versus agreeing-view results with actual denominators. Q8 uses a second person's 30-second pulse count and oximeter when available. Breathing is checked against counted breaths, paced/natural separately. Missing or failed measurements stay in the denominator; no participants means not measured, not zero error |

Core required scenarios are V05/06/07/08/09/39 and D08/09. The other rows preserve the critical-path and integration obligations of E06's consumers. E30 scenarios remain optional integration evidence until that provider is installed; its absence is never evidence those scenarios passed. A single-camera run proves T0, not the multi-camera agreeing clause of D09. Hardware absence leaves that clause open.

## Gates and hand-in

tasks.json supplies exact uv commands, not executed results. Each task runs its tests, ruff/format, mypy --strict and relevant import-linter. T1's member contracts must inspect the worker and reject hub implementation/SQL/model imports; a hub-only discovery pass is insufficient. T2 reuses E21's runner architecture and introduces no production package. C4 must make the existing safety/trace/mutations gate enforce separate 95% branch coverage on worker domain/application decisions; combined pytest-cov alone cannot greenlight.

Require nonempty collection, all scoped clauses, the required LIVE/venue evidence, full relevant regression suites after fixes, E20 CI, resolved independent review and coordinator AI-use rows. No threshold tuning, skipped clause or SIM result can earn missing LIVE acceptance. Numerical verification, model validation, clinical validation and mission acceptance stay separate. This run validates planning artifacts only and claims no implementation, hardware, CI or independent review result.
